raw.buffDescription: The Defender takes no damage from [k=glossary/dmg_effects]Damaging Debuffs[/k], and has a Knockout Shield that heals them for 10% of their Max Health whenever they would be Knocked Out. If the Shield is not already disabled, knocking down the Defender disables it for 0.80 seconds. Each time this happens, its downtime increases by 0.80 seconds up to 5.60 seconds.
